body_markdown:
NORTH BETHESDA, Md., Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Xometry, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DdoShA0zwepuTTBTCImrJCYmHdUcN0r8bZaZwQg2mx_8LULao7II6C7vTqJIJiQiKC1Z2itUBfQApi52iw0oXQ==) (NASDAQ:XMTR), the global, AI-native marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers of custom manufacturing, announced that members of its management team will attend the following investor events:


- Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026: Tuesday, September 8, in San Francisco – including a fireside chat at 3:45 p.m. PT
- Citi’s 2026 Global TMT Conference: Thursday, September 10, in New York City


The webcast and replay of the fireside chat will be accessible within the[Investor Relations section of Xometry’s website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mtX5eYBrgr6f6Ulsr0TwPFiruPDe5h-Oc1a6jxNLFY9G1vQ8x2usEv37zr6t7AkvEDDVYhf5Gfs9AeufN8EItMu7fiGHE-UBR3-KmTEFGm2U1rsWGbxoxT8ZuXkF9UeUq6-z8VlbRSbKEYT9mbHBow==) following the session.


**About Xometry**
[Xometry’s](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DdoShA0zwepuTTBTCImrJNotQ-4UzVSs3v0CbXrrH-jj3GwUXtHwTe-mVXn-6JCmcnmb6mJ5wKz93RNXLa6qHw==) (NASDAQ: XMTR) AI-native marketplace, popular[Thomas](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zRTlPkgGuaQgpbudm13vOfbi2kAF_c3acXRqy1LH68WWwHzTvgz8Tax0krCaekIE16bPqEKbmQEx3gKYPz1uuQ==) industrial sourcing platform and suite of cloud-based services are rapidly digitizing the manufacturing industry. Xometry provides manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their businesses and streamlines the procurement process for buyers through real-time pricing and lead time data. Learn more at[xometry.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Ah3cwHnggJG8QrdAyhKFfwUS8L5CTD81FMieRRFAdK3hQYMBb1BlG5IhAnkdUFNyuU4tRBlfwMaqoIfX6nO6hw==) or follow[Xometry on LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DdoShA0zwepuTTBTCImrJAFHhWa2GNj2SmAJFKnxcys0sfwO5cjXRoUyArO1pJO-eKGcktuW-YMg--_7aEpEhmz8rTr68ECzbluvjK4ZyxrTL_QmxCm0UgrLN69X6DSx) .
